intro.zh: 试菜刚结束，莉瑟提着灯来到尚未营业的驿站。
intro.en: The practice meal has just ended when Lyse arrives with her lantern. The waystation is not open yet.

outro.zh: 三人约好只调查入口附近。夜路上，提灯成为他们共同的方向。
outro.en: The three agree to inspect only the entrance. On the evening road, the lantern gives them a shared direction.
